topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Well, there’s been a turn in the wind, as they say. Old Ma wouldn’t be leaving us, not without a reason. Her house, now passed to her two young ones. I remember when she first came to these parts, her hands as sturdy as the oak, now returned to the earth. The house stands, silent and a bit lonesome, waiting for new life. The garden’s bounds will miss her tender care; she could make the wildest flowers bow their heads in peace. I’ve been thinking about the soil, how it holds memories deeper than roots. The young ones have a lot to learn, but the earth, it doesn’t forget. It’s a heavy thing, taking on what was once another’s toil and joy.
